_comment: Pipeline calibration data. Updated manually after reviewing PR results.
_instructions: After each PR review, update metrics below. This tracks precision/recall over time.

severity_weights._comment: Adjust these if P0/P1/P2 scoring is too aggressive or too lenient

risk_router_thresholds._comment: Tune these based on false negative rate (missed issues on skipped agents)

dedup_settings._comment: Tune based on duplicate rate. Lower similarity = more aggressive merging.

historical_metrics._comment: Fill after each PR. Format: { pr: number, date: string, raw: number, deduped: number, true_positives: number, false_positives: number, missed_in_prod: number }

known_false_positives._comment: Patterns that agents flag incorrectly. Add here to suppress in future.

critical_paths._comment: Files/patterns that always trigger high-risk. Update as codebase evolves.
